definitions.gloss: slump; losing streak; dry spell; rut
definitions.explanation: A period of poor performance or diminished output, particularly in sports, creative work, or business. From English "slump".

examples.japanese: スランプを{脱|だっ}した。
examples.english: He got out of his slump.

examples.japanese: {打撃|だげき}スランプが{続|つづ}いて{打率|だりつ}が{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: A hitting slump continued and his batting average dropped.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{作家|さっか}でも、{創作|そうさく}スランプに{陥|おちい}ることがある。
examples.english: Even a veteran writer can fall into a creative slump.

notes:
Used in sports, creative, and business contexts. Commonly appears as a compound modifier (打撃スランプ, 創作スランプ) or standalone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スランプを{脱|だっ}する: to get out of a slump
- スランプに{陥|おちい}る: to fall into a slump
- スランプが{続|つづ}く: slump continues
- スランプから{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す: to break out of a slump

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不調|ふちょう}: poor condition — more general; can refer to physical condition, machine malfunction, etc.
- ビハインド: trailing (in score) — refers to current deficit, not a performance trend
